evals.name: pr-number-review-flow
evals.prompt: Review Kubernetes Spanish translation PR 55868 in the local kubernetes website repo.
evals.expected: The skill treats 55868 as a pull request number, fetches the changed Spanish documentation files, maps each edited content/es path to its English source path, checks structural fidelity before wording, and returns a severity-ranked review report with a final verdict.

evals.name: pr-url-review-flow
evals.expected: The skill extracts the repository and PR number from the URL, reviews the PR as a Kubernetes website translation change, and reports findings grouped by file and severity.

evals.name: english-source-mapping
evals.prompt: Compare content/es/training/_index.html against its English source.
evals.expected: The skill maps content/es/training/_index.html to content/en/training/_index.html, checks headings, paragraphs, lists, code blocks, and other meaning-bearing structure, and flags any missing or structurally divergent content.

evals.name: language-and-tone-review
evals.prompt: Identify Spanish grammar, typo, and tone issues in this Kubernetes translation PR.
evals.expected: The skill checks grammar, spelling, punctuation, literal translation artifacts, terminology consistency, and tone against nearby Spanish Kubernetes docs or fallback Spanish documentation references when the section is new.

evals.name: github-cli-fallback
evals.prompt: The local checkout does not have the PR branch. How should the skill fetch PR metadata and diff details?
evals.expected: The skill instructs the reviewer to use GitHub CLI commands such as gh auth status, gh repo set-default kubernetes/website, gh pr view, gh pr diff, gh pr view --comments, and gh pr checkout when local context is incomplete.

evals.name: draft-review-comments
evals.prompt: Return comment-ready suggestions for a translation that is structurally correct but uses awkward literal Spanish.
evals.expected: The skill converts findings into short reviewer comments that explain the issue, distinguish translation accuracy from style, and suggest replacement wording or requested changes that can be pasted into GitHub.
